description_en: On Friday night, a witness observed four unknown individuals breaking into the storeroom of a kiosk in Vegesack and alerted the police. Quickly arriving police units were still able to apprehend a suspect. The burglars first unscrewed a wooden board in front of a window of the kiosk on Zur Vegesacker Fähre street and then smashed the glass pane behind it with a paving stone to get into the storeroom. One of the fleeing perpetrators apparently sustained minor injuries in the process. Before they fled, the intruders transported several crates of drinks outside with a wheelchair. An 18-year-old suspect was apprehended by the police while fleeing, and two crates of beer were recovered near the crime scene. Investigations against him and his hitherto unknown accomplices for aggravated burglary are ongoing.
review_notes: The report describes police apprehending an 18-year-old burglary suspect while fleeing. The assigned topic accurately represents the incident.

title_en: After knife attack: Police arrest suspect
description_en: Following the knife attack on Friday morning in the station district, which we reported under press release no. 0043, the police arrested a 35-year-old suspect on Saturday night. A 33-year-old man was critically injured with a knife on Friday morning at the station square. The police were able to identify the perpetrator via the video control center. Emergency forces then arrested the 35-year-old suspect that same night in the vicinity of the station. Grounds for detention are currently being examined for the homeless man of Turkish nationality. Police and the public prosecutor's office in Bremen are investigating for attempted homicide.
review_notes: The report mainly describes the arrest of a suspect following a knife attack, but also discusses an ongoing investigation and the public prosecutor.

title_en: Color slogans at school and university in Horn
description_en: Over the weekend, a school and a university in Horn-Lehe were defaced with paint. The police are looking for witnesses. Unknown perpetrators sprayed several politically motivated slogans, such as "FCK Linke", "Deutschland braucht rechts" (Germany needs right-wing), with red and blue paint on an exterior facade, a stairwell, and the sports hall of the high school on Vorkampsweg. The caretaker discovered the graffiti on Sunday and alerted the police. On Sunday evening, employees of a security service discovered graffiti in red paint at the university in the area of the University Boulevard. Unknown individuals had sprayed a total of 26 political slogans, such as "Nazis aufs Maul" (Punch Nazis), "Antifa in der Offensive" (Antifa on the Offensive), on the sidewalk, on pillars, and on trash cans. The State Security Department of the Bremen Police has launched an investigation.
review_notes: The report describes graffiti and paint damage at a school and university. The assigned topic accurately represents the incident.

title_en: Checks in the station quarter - Man coughs cocaine from his mouth
description_en: The Bremen Police conducted checks from Saturday until late at night in the station district. More than 20 people were checked, and knives, cannabis, and cocaine were confiscated. In addition to combating visible drug and street crime in the station forecourt area, the control of the weapons ban zone was also a focus for the emergency services. A total of 26 people were checked, and various violations of the Weapons Act were found. The officers confiscated several knives and several units of cannabis for sale. During one check, a man had to cough and, in doing so, lost 20 units of cocaine from his mouth. During a subsequent apartment search, the emergency services found several mobile phones, cash, and further evidence. A physical altercation was reported in the area of the station forecourt via the video control center. The emergency services apprehended a 29-year-old man at the scene. Corresponding criminal charges were filed, and seven evictions were issued. Further investigations into this are ongoing. This coordinated action was part of ongoing efforts to further improve safety and order in this area. The Bremen Police have been intensifying their efforts to combat street crime for many weeks and months and will continue these efforts with other security authorities.
review_notes: The report describes police checks involving cannabis and cocaine seizures. Drug-related offences are a major theme.

description_en: On Saturday, SV Werder Bremen will host SC Freiburg at 3:30 PM in the Weserstadion. The organizer expects a sold-out stadium. The usual traffic concept will be applied: Osterdeich will be closed to private traffic between Sielwall and Stader Straße approximately two and a half hours before and about one hour after the end of the game. No parking spaces are available at or in the immediate vicinity of the stadium. Short-term road closures by the police due to operational measures in the stadium area and throughout the city center are possible. Furthermore, there will be a fan march from the market square to the Weserstadion. For these reasons, disruptions to private and public transport may occur. Due to ongoing construction work on the Weserbrücke (Weser Bridge), significant traffic disruptions are expected in both directions on the BAB 1 (motorway A1). In the vicinity of football matches, there is a recurring increase in car break-ins. The police advise: Do not leave any valuables in your vehicles.
review_notes: The report focuses on a football match, road closures, traffic disruptions and public safety measures.

title_en: Very successful control and presence measures in the Bremen station district
description_en: To combat violence and weapons ban offenses, Bremen police on Friday, in close cooperation with the Federal Police, the Public Order Office, and DB Security, carried out extensive control and presence measures in the station district. Almost 70 officers were deployed from Friday afternoon into the night hours to increase security in the station quarter. In the course of the measures, a total of 346 people were checked and 42 temporary exclusions from the area were issued. The officers seized numerous weapons, narcotics, and other evidence. Eight criminal charges were filed, including violations of the Narcotics Act and the Weapons Act. Already at the beginning of the operation, plainclothes officers succeeded in apprehending a car burglar in the area of Friedrich-Rauers-Straße. Shortly thereafter, a major altercation involving iron chains occurred in Nelson Mandela Park, during which three fleeing suspects were apprehended in Bürgerpark. In addition, the officers targeted several individuals from the drug dealing environment: On Hillmannplatz, a minor female buyer was apprehended who had been reported missing. The drugs she had purchased were seized, and subsequent measures initiated against the dealer led to a house search.
review_notes: The report describes a broad police operation involving drug offences, weapons, violence and arrests. Drug-related offences are relevant, but the report covers several policing activities.

description_en: In Burglesum, unknown perpetrators sprayed swastikas and other unconstitutional symbols on the exterior facade of a school in the Lesum district in recent days. The police are looking for witnesses.The police were called on Thursday morning to the school grounds on Steinkamp street due to several black graffiti writings, including swastikas, SS runes, and "Heil Hitler". The act is believed to have occurred between Tuesday afternoon and Thursday morning.The criminal police immediately launched an investigation.
review_notes: The report describes graffiti and unconstitutional symbols sprayed onto a school building. The assigned topic accurately reflects the incident.

description_en:
A 24-year-old parcel delivery driver was robbed by two unknown perpetrators in Burglesum on Wednesday morning. The police are looking for witnesses.

Around 11:50 AM, the 24-year-old was on Grönlandstraße, in the process of loading parcels from his van, when the two unknown individuals approached him. They demanded a parcel allegedly intended for them, whereupon the 24-year-old said that he could not hand over parcels on the street. Subsequently, one of the perpetrators pushed him back and held a knife directly to his chest. Then the robbers were apparently distracted by a noise, allowing the delivery driver to flee into his van and drive away. He remained unharmed during the incident. He alerted the police a little later. The criminal police have launched an investigation and are looking for witnesses.

The perpetrators were described as follows:
The man with the knife was approximately 25 to 30 years old and about 185 cm tall. He reportedly had black, short, curly hair. The 24-year-old could not provide any further details. He could only describe the second man as being slightly shorter than the first.
review_notes: The report describes an attempted robbery involving a knife and includes physical descriptions of the suspects. The assigned topic is appropriate.

title_en: Serious traffic accident on motorway feeder road
description_en:
On Wednesday morning, a traffic accident occurred on the Überseestadt motorway feeder road between a motorcycle and a car. A 34-year-old man sustained life-threatening injuries. Subsequently, there were significant traffic obstructions.

Around 06:50 AM, a 19-year-old man was driving his Volkswagen Passat on the Überseestadt motorway feeder road in an outbound direction and intended to turn left into Ingolstädter Straße. At this time, the 34-year-old motorcyclist was on the opposite side, driving in an inbound direction. According to initial witness statements, the 19-year-old ran a red light and hit the motorcyclist in the intersection. The 34-year-old was thrown several meters into the air from his motorcycle by the impact and landed on the ground. He was taken to a hospital with life-threatening injuries. The 19-year-old also had to be taken to a hospital by emergency services with serious injuries. Both the motorcycle and the Passat had to be towed away. Property damage amounting to 32,000 Euros was incurred.

During the accident investigation and cleanup, the Überseestadt motorway feeder road had to be temporarily closed, which led to significant traffic obstructions. The Bremen Police Traffic Department has commenced investigations.
review_notes: The report describes a serious collision between a car and a motorcycle, resulting in injuries and traffic disruption. The assigned topic accurately represents the incident.

description_en: On Wednesday night, unknown persons set tires on fire on roadways in Neustadt and damaged a government building. A witness observed around 2:45 AM how several masked and dark-clad individuals deposited car tires on Friesenwerder and Am Neustadtsbahnhof streets and set them on fire. A tire was ignited on each of the four lanes, completely blocking both carriageways. The perpetrators then fled on foot. During the firefighting efforts, emergency services also found, a few meters away, damage to the facade of the Bundeswehr Career Center and the office of the main customs office Bremen in Große Sortillienstraße. Colored liquids were apparently thrown against the building using filled glasses. Some window panes were damaged in the process. On one side of the building, a large lettering "NO WAR" was applied. The entrance door showed clear signs of blunt force - however, entry into the building did not occur. The police cordoned off the area for the duration of the firefighting and cleaning work. Even before the start of the morning rush hour, the roadways were reopened. The resulting property damage is estimated at a sum in the lower five-figure range.
review_notes: The report describes damage to a government building, broken windows and graffiti, alongside burning tyres. Property damage and graffiti are important elements of the incident.

description_en: Bremen Police carried out extensive measures to combat drug trafficking around the main train station and in Bremen's Viertel district from Wednesday afternoon until late in the evening. Drugs and cash were seized, and suspected dealers were apprehended. Furthermore, kiosks, snack bars, and bars were inspected in Steintor, Neustadt, and Huchting, in cooperation with the public order office, customs, tax and building authorities, and food surveillance, with some serious deficiencies being identified. Starting at approximately 3:00 PM, the deployed forces carried out overt and covert operations in the station district and in Steintor. During the extensive checks, several drug deals were stopped, criminal charges were filed, narcotics and cash were seized, and street dealers were apprehended. During a court-ordered apartment search in the station forecourt area following a street deal, officers found more than half a kilogram of cannabis, several units of cocaine for sale, a significant sum of cash, as well as packaging material, precision scales, and further evidence. Furthermore, police officers issued various orders to leave the premises. In the Östliche Vorstadt, Neustadt, and Huchting, a total of eleven establishments were simultaneously the focus of the deployed forces in the evening. Here, various, partly serious, violations were identified, such as significant hygiene deficiencies, including spoiled food, illegal employment, violations of the Narcotics Act, labeling requirements, and the Packaging Act, as well as cash register irregularities. Nitrous oxide was seized in a kiosk. Corresponding charges were filed. For many weeks and months, Bremen Police has been increasingly committed to combating street crime and will continue these efforts together with other security authorities.
review_notes: The report primarily describes police operations against drug trafficking, including drug seizures and arrests. Other regulatory violations are also mentioned, but the assigned topic is appropriate.

description_en:
An unknown perpetrator robbed a kiosk in Woltmershausen on Tuesday evening, stealing cash and then fleeing. The police are looking for witnesses.Around 9:05 PM, the man entered the shop on Woltmershauser Straße and engaged the 29-year-old employee in a conversation and asked to be shown goods. When the woman subsequently opened the till, the perpetrator suddenly had a knife in his hand, grabbed money from the till and fled in an unknown direction.
The criminal police have launched an investigation and are looking for witnesses. The man was described as follows: He was approximately 180 cm tall, slim, and about 20 years old. He had black skin and was wearing black trousers and a black top.
review_notes: The report describes a kiosk robbery involving a knife and provides a physical description of the suspect. The assigned topic accurately represents the incident.

title_en: Teenage girls apprehended after attack on 15-year-old
description_en:
Bremen police officers apprehended two teenage girls, aged 15 and 17, in the Mittelshuchting district on Monday. They are alleged to have previously beaten a 15-year-old and taken her money and cigarettes.

The 15-year-old was on Flämische Straße around 1:10 PM when she was approached by two girls. Shortly thereafter, the duo pushed and beat the 15-year-old and insulted her. Subsequently, the attackers demanded that she give them her money and cigarettes, which she did. The young girl then boarded a bus towards Roland Center, while being followed by the duo. The alerted police officers apprehended the two 15 and 17-year-old girls still at the scene. The police also found pepper spray on the 17-year-old, which was confiscated. The two girls were subsequently handed over into the custody of their parents.

Criminal charges were filed for extortionate robbery and bodily harm. The investigations are ongoing.
review_notes: The report describes police apprehending two teenage suspects following an assault and robbery. The assigned topic appropriately captures the apprehension.

description_en:
In the early morning hours of Friday, police in the city center arrested a man after he had broken into a restaurant. He is suspected of having committed further offenses and remains in custody.

The operator of a restaurant on Tiefer street in Bremen's Old Town was alerted to an intruder in his premises by surveillance technology around 2:10 AM. The alerted emergency forces were able to arrest the burglar as he was leaving the building. They found burglary tools in his pockets and searched his apartment for further evidence. Through video recordings, the 27-year-old could be proven to have broken into the same premises a few days earlier. In the current investigations, his involvement in further criminal offenses is being examined. A custody review is currently underway at the Bremen public prosecutor's office.
review_notes: The report describes a burglary suspect being arrested and investigated for further offences. Although investigations are relevant, police apprehension may better represent the main event.

description_en: Police units apprehended a drug dealer in the Bahnhofvorstadt on the night from Friday to Saturday. He was provisionally arrested despite resistance, and his apartment was searched. Around 01:10 AM, patrolling police units encountered a man at the Bahnhofplatz who conspicuously tried to remove himself quickly from the sight and reach of the law enforcement officers. The attentive police officers, however, stopped him, during which he attempted to swallow small sales packages of cocaine. He also had narcotics and cash in his pockets. The 28-year-old continuously resisted the provisional arrest and the subsequent measures at a police station; no one was injured during this. During the search of his apartment, the police units seized several sales units of cocaine, cash, his mobile phone, and further evidence. Investigations into the suspicion of commercial drug trafficking against the man known to the police are ongoing. Additionally, charges were filed for resisting law enforcement officers.
review_notes: The report primarily concerns suspected drug trafficking, including cocaine possession, seizure of narcotics and cash, and an investigation into commercial drug dealing.

title_en: Anonymous tip portal launched for the Waller Friedhof homicide - Bremen Police asks for tips
description_en: Following the discovery of a 40-year-old man found dead in the Walle district on Thursday morning, the homicide commission announces the following and asks for help. Investigators assume an altercation involving the use of a knife. The traces secured at the crime scene are currently being intensively evaluated. The homicide commission now asks: "Who noticed anything suspicious in the area of Jadestraße and the Walle cemetery on Wednesday evening and in the night leading up to Thursday? Who was told about an altercation at the Walle cemetery?"
review_notes: The report concerns a homicide investigation and an appeal for witnesses. It does not describe graffiti or property damage. Topic 6 is more appropriate.

description_en: A 30-year-old man was injured with a knife in Gröpelingen in the night from Saturday to Sunday during an altercation with family members. During the recording of the facts, the emergency services found that there was an open arrest warrant against him. Around 11:15 p.m., the injured 30-year-old was reported to the emergency services in an establishment on Gröpelinger Heerstraße. On site, the police immediately administered first aid. The man stated that he was attacked by family members and injured with a knife on his arm. In the further course of events, the emergency services found that there was an open arrest warrant against the 30-year-old. Furthermore, he had been deported from Germany in 2019 and would not have been allowed to re-enter legally this year. After his injuries were treated in the hospital, he was transferred to a correctional facility. In addition, the emergency services filed another report due to suspected illegal entry. Further investigations are ongoing. Due to the attack on him, several of his family members were apprehended and initial evidence was secured, including a knife. Here too, further investigations regarding grievous bodily harm are ongoing.
review_notes: The report includes an outstanding arrest warrant, transfer to a correctional facility, and apprehension of suspects. Although it also concerns a knife attack, the assigned topic is reasonable.

description_en:
Unknown persons spray-painted several electricity boxes with Palestine flags in the Ostertor district over the weekend. The criminal police are investigating and looking for witnesses.

Passers-by noticed the property damage on Sunday afternoon and alerted the police. Hitherto unknown perpetrators spray-painted Palestine flags in black, red, and green colours on around 19 electricity boxes between Am Dobben and Vor dem Steintor. The criminal police have commenced investigations into property damage.
review_notes: Unknown individuals spray-painted approximately 19 electricity boxes. The report clearly concerns graffiti and property damage.

description_en: The World War II grenade found on Wednesday during exploratory work in the Kirchhuchting district has just been successfully detonated. The bomb disposal expert detonated the artillery shell at around 1:10 PM in the Park Links der Weser. Brief correction: It was a ten-kilogram grenade and not a one-kilogram grenade. No special incidents occurred; the police measures have been concluded.
review_notes: The report describes the successful detonation of a World War II grenade by a bomb disposal expert. The assigned topic accurately reflects the incident.

title_en: Gold chain robber recognized and arrested
description_en:
Plainclothes officers of the Bremen police apprehended a 28-year-old on Monday in the Östliche Vorstadt district. He is suspected of having stolen a gold chain from a 32-year-old in May.

At around 10:30 PM, the plainclothes officers were on patrol in the Hulsberg district as part of a special operation when they recognized the 28-year-old man on Am Schwarzen Meer street. He is suspected of having stolen the gold chain from a 32-year-old man on May 20th on Friedrich-Ebert-Street, using a variant of the 'Antanztrick' (distraction theft by approaching someone closely). The officers took the man to the station and confiscated his cell phone.

The 28-year-old was taken into custody; the judicial review of his detention is currently still ongoing. Further investigations, including into possible further offenses, are also ongoing.
review_notes: The report concerns the identification and arrest of a suspect in a gold-chain theft investigation. No drug-related activity is mentioned. Topic 1 is more appropriate.

description_en: On Tuesday, a World War II explosive grenade was detonated by the Bremen Police Explosive Ordnance Disposal team in the Häfen district. The approximately ten-kilogram grenade had been found during exploratory work on a factory premises on the street Auf der Reithbarke. An evacuation took place within a safety radius of 150 meters. A radius requiring air-raid precaution behavior was not necessary. During the subsequent controlled detonation in the morning by ordnance disposal expert Thomas Richter, no particular incidents occurred.
review_notes: The report describes the discovery and controlled detonation of a World War II grenade by bomb disposal experts. The assigned topic is appropriate.

description_en: Unknown persons defaced several trees in Huckelrieder Park in Neustadt with paint. The police are looking for witnesses. The vandalism was discovered on Monday morning and the police were alerted. Unknown persons had sprayed several "Z" symbols with green and white paint, as well as the lettering "Putin", on a total of twelve trees in Huckelrieder Park on Buntentorsdeich. The criminal police have launched an investigation into the endorsement of criminal acts and vandalism. The investigators are looking for witnesses and are asking anyone who has made suspicious observations in this regard.
review_notes: The report describes graffiti and vandalism involving twelve trees spray-painted with symbols and lettering. The assigned topic accurately reflects the incident.

description_en: Eight demonstrators blocked an intersection in Bremen-Mitte on Wednesday afternoon. The individuals sat down on the roadway around 3:25 PM in the area of the intersection Tiefer/Wilhelm-Kaisen-Brücke/Balgebrückstraße, thereby obstructing city-bound traffic. Of the eight individuals, five glued themselves to the roadway. Traffic was redirected by the police, leading to significant disruptions for a short time. Emergency services detached the individuals from the asphalt. Due to the weather conditions, all demonstrators were brought to a nearby police station. Their personal details will be recorded there. Further investigations into violations of the Assembly Act and the Criminal Code are ongoing.
review_notes: The report describes demonstrators blocking an intersection and police investigating possible Assembly Act violations. The assigned topic accurately reflects the event.

description_en: Even in Bremen, stories of easily earned money, Bitcoins, and cryptocurrency are repeatedly luring people onto dubious online trading platforms. The victims invest, believing they have been well advised, and never see their money again. The Bremen criminal police are currently investigating several cases of online investment fraud. The police are warning against this scam and providing safety tips. Many victims are inexperienced in online trading: Cybercriminals exploit this for their schemes, transferring their victims' money to their own accounts abroad. To acquire potential victims, cybercriminals create fraudulent investment platforms for online investments on the internet. These platforms look reputable at first glance and are advertised on trustworthy websites and currently primarily on social media like Facebook. Once the interested customer has registered online with the trading platform, they are directly contacted by the cybercriminals. The "traders" are in reality fraudsters who operate from call centers. They intensively support their "customers" via phone and messenger service. The criminals, who convincingly and confidently pose as real brokers, also often use so-called remote software (AnyDesk, Teamviewer). This is used under the pretext of explaining and setting up the user account for the customers. Meanwhile, the fraudsters unnoticeably steal data, e.g., credit card and bank account information. With the access data obtained in this way, the fraudsters later transfer further amounts to themselves without the knowledge of the victims. In Bremen, such fraudsters connected to the victims' computers via remote maintenance software and enabled online banking access. During the consultation, the victims were then pressured, after an initial rather low deposit of 250 Euros, to transfer increasingly larger sums to their supposedly newly established investment accounts, for example in Austria and Latvia. The private investors could see on these accounts how their invested capital rapidly grew and, at the prompting of their "brokers," made increasingly higher deposits. In reality, at this point, the alleged financial advisors had already siphoned off their investors' money. The investment account never actually existed; no customer ever got their money. The police warn and give tips:
review_notes: The report concerns online investment fraud involving fake cryptocurrency trading platforms and the theft of victims' money and banking information. The assigned topic is appropriate.

description_en:
Two 17 and 18-year-olds stole a smartphone from a 21-year-old Bremen resident in the city center on Sunday night, using a variation of the distraction dance trick. The police were able to apprehend the suspected perpetrators and provisionally arrest them.

Plainclothes officers of the Federal Police observed the two as they approached the intoxicated 21-year-old at Hillmannplatz, hugged him, pulled the phone from his pocket, and fled. The two Albanian thieves were apprehended shortly thereafter by Bremen Police forces as part of a search operation. In the 18-year-old's sock, a gold chain, presumably also stolen, with a small diamond-set compass as a pendant, was found and secured. Further investigations are ongoing.

The distraction dance trick is a known form of pickpocketing, which can also escalate into robbery. The pickpocket acts supposedly friendly, greets the victim effusively, high-fives them, and puts an arm around them to dance with them or places their leg between the victim's to show a soccer trick. The pickpocket or an accomplice exploits this inattention to steal valuables. Preferred targets are cell phones, gold chains, and wallets. Perpetrators have an easy time with intoxicated individuals. The Bremen Police therefore advise: Pay attention to your valuables! Store valuables in lockable inner pockets and do not carry your cell phone or wallet loosely in your trouser pocket. Only take as much cash with you as you actually need.
review_notes: The report describes smartphone theft using a distraction technique. Although suspects were arrested, theft is the central offence and the assigned topic is appropriate.

title_en: Taxi ride to Bremen ends with robbery
description_en: A taxi driver drove a passenger from Oldenburg to Bremen in the night from Wednesday to Thursday. Once in the Hanseatic city, the passenger threatened him with a knife and stole cash. The unknown man got into the 31-year-old's taxi in the city center of Oldenburg, paid in advance, and asked to be driven to the Bremen train station district. On Bornstraße, he exited the car and asked the driver to wait. A few minutes later, the passenger returned, threatened the 31-year-old man with a knife, and demanded cash. The robber then fled in the direction of Am Wandrahm street. He was described as approximately 170 centimeters tall, with a dark complexion and a full beard. The man was wearing a gray baseball cap and dark clothing.
review_notes: The report describes a taxi driver being threatened with a knife and robbed of cash. A description of the fleeing suspect is also provided. The assigned topic accurately reflects the incident.

description_en: A burglar broke into an apartment in the Bahnhofsvorstadt in the early morning hours. The man injured a 14-year-old boy with pepper spray and stole valuables. The unknown perpetrator entered the first floor of an apartment building on Contrescarpe through a balcony door and searched the room of the sleeping 14-year-old. When the boy woke up due to the noise, the burglar sprayed him in the face with irritant gas, grabbed several cell phones, an iPad, and a wallet, and fled with the loot. The teenager woke his parents, who then notified the police. An ambulance took the boy to a hospital as a precaution. The police ask: Who saw a suspicious person on Friday morning, around 5 AM, on Contrescarpe, in the area between Herdentor and Bürgermeister-Smidt-Straße? The robber was dressed in dark clothing, wore a leather jacket, and is said to be about 170 centimeters tall.
review_notes: The report describes a violent burglary involving the theft of valuables and an unknown perpetrator. The suspect's physical appearance and clothing are also described, making the assigned topic appropriate.

description_en: On Monday afternoon, a witness reported a burglary in Bremen's Ostertor district. After the arrival of emergency services, the suspect could be apprehended at the scene a short time later. Around 6 PM, emergency services were called to Contrescarpe Street due to a burglary. An attentive neighbor observed a man smashing a window with a stone, thereby gaining access to the premises. The rapidly arriving emergency services, with the help of police dog Forrest, apprehended the suspect in the restroom. The man allowed himself to be arrested by the officers without resistance. The 41-year-old complained of chest pains, so he was preventively taken to a hospital. No further treatment was necessary; he was temporarily arrested. Investigations are ongoing, including whether the man is considered a suspect for further offenses.
review_notes: Police apprehended a burglary suspect at the scene with the assistance of a police dog. The arrest is central to the report and matches the assigned topic.

description_en:
On Wednesday evening, a hitherto unknown perpetrator robbed a discount store in Osterholz-Tenever. The man threatened an employee with a firearm. The police are looking for witnesses.

At around 5:40 PM, the alleged customer entered the market on Schevemoorer Landstraße and placed sweets on the conveyor belt at the checkout. When the employee opened the cash drawer to process the payment, the young perpetrator suddenly threatened the cashier with a black firearm and demanded cash. After the robber had taken several banknotes from the open cash drawer, he fled in the direction of Luganer Straße.

The perpetrator was described as being around 16 to 17 years old, approximately 1.70 meters tall, dark-haired, and plump. At the time of the crime, he was wearing a medical mask, a black leather jacket with a wine-red t-shirt underneath, blue jeans, and a grey cap.
review_notes: The report describes an armed robbery at a discount store, followed by the perpetrator's escape. A detailed suspect description is provided, making the assigned topic appropriate.

title_en: Home game SV Werder Bremen against VfL Bochum
description_en: On Saturday at 3:30 PM, SV Werder Bremen plays at home against VfL Bochum. The organizer expects a sold-out stadium. Concurrently, several gatherings will take place in the city center on Saturday. Traffic obstructions, especially around the Weserstadion, are to be expected. The familiar traffic concept will be applied again. That means, the Osterdeich will be closed to individual traffic between Sielwall and Stader Straße approximately two and a half hours before and about one hour after the end of the game. The Bremen police therefore recommend that spectators arriving by vehicle use the offered Park+Ride service from Hemelinger Hafendamm. In the vicinity of football matches, car break-ins occur repeatedly. Please do not leave any valuables in the vehicles. The parking spaces at the stadium are still only available to authorized persons with a corresponding parking permit.
review_notes: The report concerns a Werder Bremen football match, including stadium attendance, road closures, parking restrictions and public safety advice. The assigned topic accurately reflects the main subject.

description_en:
A man shot a passer-by in Huchting on Friday afternoon with a blank-firing pistol, injuring him in the leg. The perpetrator was arrested and admitted to a psychiatric hospital.
The 29-year-old walked through Mittelshuchting and threatened motorists and other road users with a firearm. On Kirchhuchtinger Landstraße, he encountered a 24-year-old from Bremen and apparently shot him in the leg without provocation. The shooter fled across the state border and was apprehended there by the Lower Saxony police, then subsequently handed over to their colleagues from Bremen. Due to the suspicion of a mental illness, he was temporarily placed in a psychiatric hospital.
The 24-year-old was injured by a metal pellet from the weapon and had to be treated as an outpatient in a hospital; he also suffered shock.
review_notes: The report describes a shooting followed by the apprehension of the suspect by police. Although the incident involves violence, the suspect's arrest is a prominent part of the report, making the assigned topic reasonable.

title_en: Traffic jam after traffic accidents on the motorway
description_en: On Thursday afternoon, several traffic accidents occurred on the A 27 at the Horn junction in the direction of Cuxhaven. According to current findings, no one was injured. The motorway had to be temporarily completely closed, which led to significant traffic disruptions. A 62-year-old driver was driving his Citroen on the A 27 when he had to brake due to traffic near the Horn exit. A 66-year-old Daimler driver following behind noticed this too late, could not brake in time and rear-ended him. A short time later, a 48-year-old driver overlooked the traffic jam caused by the accident and drove her Hyundai into a Ford Focus. Due to the collision, the Ford was pushed into a VW Sharan, which then collided with an Opel driving in front of it. Property damage occurred to all vehicles. Due to leaking operating fluids and vehicles no longer roadworthy, the motorway in the direction of Cuxhaven had to be completely closed until approximately 7 p.m. Traffic was diverted via the parallel lane. This led to massive traffic obstructions. During the accident investigation, the emergency services found that the 46-year-old Opel driver was not in possession of a valid driver's license. A criminal complaint for driving without a license was filed. The traffic accident department has begun investigations.
review_notes: The report mainly describes multiple motorway collisions, vehicle damage, road closures and traffic disruption. The assigned traffic accident topic accurately represents the incident.

description_en:
On Tuesday afternoon, police officers in Gröpelingen and the Bahnhofsvorstadt district apprehended four men aged 26, 30, 34, and 39, and during searches, found drugs including heroin, cocaine, and cannabis. They also seized cash, mobile phones, and other evidence.

First, plainclothes officers searched an apartment on Lupinenstraße at 12:05 PM. Prior to this, they had found drugs on a man who had briefly entered and immediately left the house. As they entered the premises, a 30-year-old jumped out of the window and attempted to flee. Police apprehended him and another man aged 34. The officers subsequently found larger quantities of heroin, cocaine, and cannabis. They also seized cash, several mobile phones, and other evidence. The 30-year-old was treated by paramedics because he had sustained minor injuries from the jump. The police filed criminal charges against both men on suspicion of drug trafficking. Further investigations are ongoing.

At around 2:15 PM, a police patrol, as part of targeted operations, stopped a 39-year-old on Breitenweg. They initially found a small quantity of drugs on him. During a subsequent apartment search, officers found heroin, cocaine, ecstasy, and cannabis, as well as cash and other evidence. The officers filed criminal charges, including on suspicion of drug trafficking, against the 39-year-old and his 26-year-old roommate. Further investigations are ongoing.
review_notes: The report describes police operations targeting suspected drug trafficking, including arrests and seizures of heroin, cocaine, cannabis and ecstasy. Drug-related offences are the central subject.

description_en: An armed robber attacked a gas station in Kirchhuchting on Sunday evening. The masked man stole cash and fled undetected. Around 9 PM, the man entered the salesroom of the gas station on Kirchhuchtinger Landstraße. He threatened the 25-year-old employee with a firearm and took cash from the register. Afterwards, he fled with the loot on a bicycle in the direction of Moordeicher Landstraße. The robber was described as being about 25 years old and 180 centimeters tall. He wore a black hooded jacket and dark Adidas brand jogging pants with white stripes. Furthermore, the man was equipped with sunglasses with a blue mirror finish.
review_notes: The report describes an armed robbery at a gas station, including the theft of cash and a physical description of the fleeing suspect. The assigned topic is appropriate.

description_en: On Saturday morning, a 34-year-old female pedestrian was hit by a tram in Walle and seriously injured. According to current information, the woman wanted to cross Waller Heerstraße at approximately 10:10 AM and failed to notice the approaching tram. She was hit head-on by the tram and seriously injured. Bremen police officers provided initial first aid before the woman was subsequently taken to a hospital by paramedics. Several witnesses stated that the woman allegedly crossed the street against a red light. Both Waller Heerstraße and public transport had to be closed for about an hour in the outbound direction. The police have started investigations into the cause of the accident.
review_notes: The report describes a pedestrian being struck by a tram, resulting in serious injuries and traffic disruption. The assigned traffic accident topic is appropriate.

description_en: The Bremen law enforcement authorities recorded their next success on Thursday in connection with the Enrcochat investigations. Following searches of four properties in Bremen and Lower Saxony, another arrest warrant could be executed and various pieces of evidence seized. In the course of the Enrcochat investigation procedure, investigators and special forces of the Bremen police, with support from police forces from Lower Saxony, searched a total of four residences in the morning hours. Two men, aged 24 and 47, and a 51-year-old woman are accused of multiple acts of commercial drug trafficking. The 47-year-old from Bremen was arrested on the basis of a pre-trial detention warrant. The officers seized several electronic storage devices and smaller quantities of narcotics. Furthermore, asset freezes amounting to more than 250,000 Euros could be secured. The complex investigations against the suspects, led by the public prosecutor's office, are ongoing; further information will be provided by the Bremen Public Prosecutor's Office.
review_notes: The report concerns an ongoing Encrochat investigation, including searches, an arrest and evidence seizures. However, the underlying offences involve commercial drug trafficking. Both investigation-related and drug-related topics are reasonable.

description_en: The 14-year-old from Bremen Walle, missing since 11.07.2022 (See PM 0448), has returned. Federal Police officers took the teenager, who had been reported missing since last week, into their custody at Cologne Central Station. Further investigations into the background are ongoing. The Bremen Police request the deletion of the public appeal and the photos.
review_notes: The report provides an update on a missing-person investigation and requests removal of a previous public appeal. The assigned topic is appropriate.

description_en:
Early on Wednesday morning, a van collided with a tram in the Bahnhofsvorstadt district. Both drivers were injured. The car driver is under investigation. The intersection was closed for several hours.
In the early morning hours, the van was driving on Breitenweg street in the direction of Nordwestknoten. According to initial investigations, the 40-year-old car driver overlooked a red light at Bahnhofstraße and collided with a tram approaching from the left. During the collision, the front part of the tram derailed.
The 28-year-old tram driver was slightly injured. The 40-year-old car driver was taken to a hospital and admitted for inpatient treatment. The approximately 20 to 30 passengers remained uninjured.
The property damage to the vehicles and the tracks is estimated at a quarter of a million euros. The traffic police department has commenced investigations.
The intersection of Breitenweg and Bahnhofstraße was completely closed for approximately three hours. At 08:20 AM, all traffic measures were lifted.
review_notes: The report describes a collision between a van and a tram, resulting in injuries, property damage and traffic disruption. The assigned topic accurately represents the incident.

description_en: An unknown man robbed a petrol station in Tenever on Friday afternoon, threatened the 27-year-old employee with a knife, stole cash and fled. The police are looking for witnesses. Around 4:15 PM, the man entered the petrol station on Osterholzer Heerstraße and went directly to the sales counter. He pulled out a knife, hit the counter with the hilt and demanded the employee give him money from the till. After the woman opened the till, he reached in, took several banknotes and ran out of the building. He ran along Osterholzer Heerstraße towards the city centre. The perpetrator was described as follows: He was approximately 170 to 180 cm tall, about 25 years old and powerfully built. He was wearing a black cap with the white inscription "New York Yankees". Furthermore, he wore a black and grey jacket with a white back, light blue jeans and black "Nike" brand shoes. He wore a black tube scarf and spoke German with an accent. The criminal police have started investigations and are looking for witnesses who made observations on Osterholzer Heerstraße or in the immediate vicinity.
review_notes: The report describes an armed robbery at a petrol station involving a knife, stolen cash and a detailed description of the fleeing suspect. The assigned topic accurately reflects the incident.

description_en:
At 10:00 AM, witnesses reported seeing suspicious persons running away after a loud bang occurred at a house on Stolper Street. The quickly arriving emergency services found pry marks on the house. Due to the good description of the perpetrators by the witnesses, the police apprehended the 20-year-old nearby. He finally admitted to the burglary. The police secured evidence, took him to the station, and filed a corresponding criminal complaint. Further investigations are ongoing.
The Bremen Police would like to take this opportunity to commend the exemplary behavior of the witnesses, who did not put themselves in danger and subsequently called the police and contributed to the apprehension of the suspect with their description of the perpetrators.
review_notes: The report mainly describes the apprehension of a burglary suspect following witness information. Although property damage is mentioned, graffiti and property damage do not represent the central subject. Police Arrests and Apprehension is more suitable.

title_en: Police seized cannabis plants and drugs
description_en: After a resident complaint on Thursday afternoon about an overgrown hedge in Obervieland, police officers discovered that this was not the only plant growing there. Emergency services discovered 118 cannabis plants as well as approximately five kilograms of marijuana in a nearby residential building and seized the drugs. Around 11:00 AM, residents from Kattenesch contacted the public order service and complained about an untrimmed hedge. Employees of the public order office assessed the overgrown plant on site. In doing so, they noticed the smell of cannabis and fan noises in a nearby residential building. They then called the police. During a subsequent ordered search of the living premises, emergency services discovered 118 cannabis plants and approximately five kilograms of harvested marijuana, a small amount of cocaine, and cultivation equipment. No persons were in the building at the time of the search. Police officers confiscated the drugs and the cultivation material. The investigations into the perpetrators are ongoing.
review_notes: The report describes the discovery and seizure of cannabis plants, marijuana, cocaine and cultivation equipment. The assigned drug-related topic is appropriate.

description_en:
A 22-year-old Mercedes driver evaded a traffic control in the Hohentor district on Friday night to Saturday. In doing so, he damaged two cars. No one was injured in the incident. Emergency services apprehended the driver, who was obviously under the influence of alcohol, and his passenger.

Around 03:50 AM, a patrol car driving in the 30 km/h zone of Pappelstraße towards Hohentorsheerstraße noticed a car that was traveling far too fast. When the emergency services wanted to check the Mercedes driver, he continued his journey. He also did not react to police stop signals. He continued to accelerate and drove at a greatly excessive speed through Neustadt. At the intersection of Weizenkampstraße/Pappelstraße, the Mercedes driver lost control. He left the roadway and collided with an Audi Q3 parked there. Due to the force of the impact, the Audi was pushed into the VW Golf parked in front of it. Despite the accident, the fleeing driver did not let up on the accelerator. Further on, the Mercedes driver drove into oncoming traffic in the Woltmershausen district before coming to a stop in the Tabakquartier area. Police apprehended the 22-year-old and his equally 22-year-old passenger. No one was injured in the incident.

The men were provisionally arrested. A voluntarily conducted breath alcohol test on the driver showed a value of more than 1 per mille. He also consented to a voluntary blood sample. Police found a knife in the footwell of the vehicle and seized it. The Mercedes was confiscated and towed away. Criminal charges, including for endangering road traffic, were filed against the driver. Property damage of around 30,000 Euros occurred.
review_notes: The report describes a driver fleeing a police traffic stop, causing collisions and vehicle damage before being apprehended. Both road traffic accidents and police apprehension are relevant to the incident.

description_en: An unknown man posed as a police officer on Sunday evening in Huchting and fraudulently gained entry into a senior's apartment. When the stranger was discovered during the theft, he injured the 87-year-old Bremen resident and fled. The fraudster posed as a police officer and thus gained entry into the 87-year-old's apartment on Hermannsburg street around 8:50 PM. When the bogus officer then began to search the cupboards, the senior became suspicious. A physical altercation developed between the men, during which the Bremen resident was injured on the head. The unknown individual stole a wallet along with a credit card and fled. He could not be described in more detail but is believed to have been about 50 years old. An ambulance took the 87-year-old man to a hospital. The police advise: As a rule, do not let strangers into your home. Demand to see the official ID from alleged officials, for example, police officers. If you have the slightest doubt about the authenticity, call the police at the free emergency number 110. A sample of the correct blue official ID, as well as further information on the structure and appearance of the document, can be found on the Bremen Police homepage.
review_notes: The report describes a perpetrator impersonating a police officer to enter a senior's apartment and steal valuables. The assigned fraud, impersonation and theft topic accurately represents the incident.

description_en:
During the summer holidays, unknown persons vandalized a school in the Vahr district, among other things, with homophobic statements and an unconstitutional symbol. The police are investigating and seeking witnesses.

Emergency services were informed on Friday of multiple graffiti defacements at the secondary school on Konrad-Adenauer-Allee. On site, they found black graffiti on various walls and a stairwell. Unknown persons sprayed, in the period from July 22 to September 3, 2021, among other things, a swastika, as well as "Fuck LBGTQ" and "Homo shit!?" on the school. Furthermore, they painted over a rainbow flag and the slogan "JBA against Homophobia" with black paint.

The State Security Department of the Bremen Police is investigating the use of symbols of unconstitutional organizations and malicious damage to property.
review_notes: The report describes graffiti vandalism at a school, including discriminatory statements and damage to property. The assigned topic is appropriate.

title_en: Following severe arson at a youth center: Public prosecutor's office and police Bremen investigate suspects from the right-wing extremist scene
description_en: Following a fire in a youth center in Bremen last year (see also press release 115 from 2020), the Bremen police today, after extensive investigations, searched the apartments and cars of three suspects whom they classify as belonging to the right-wing extremist scene. A fire occurred on February 16, 2020, during a concert at the youth center on Friesenstraße. The damage amounted to almost 200,000 Euros; no one was injured. Under the leadership of the Bremen public prosecutor's office and the State Protection department of the Bremen police, innumerable traces were evaluated, including fingerprints from more than one hundred beer bottles; witnesses were questioned, and information was exchanged with other security authorities. The investigations into serious arson led to three men, aged 26, 32, and 37, who are associated with the right-wing extremist scene. At the request of the Bremen public prosecutor's office, the local court issued search warrants. The warrants were executed today and served to find evidence. An evaluation and further investigations are ongoing. Further questions will be answered by the Bremen public prosecutor's office.
review_notes: The report primarily describes the progress of a criminal investigation into serious arson, including evidence collection, witness interviews and searches of suspects' properties. The assigned investigation topic is appropriate.

description_en: In the past week, European traffic police forces and municipalities monitored compliance with speed limits on the roads. The Bremen police participated and recorded 5691 violations. At 37 mobile checkpoints in the Bremen city area, the task forces sanctioned 3177 violations. Additionally, 2514 speed limit violations were recorded by stationary speed cameras. The fastest speeders were registered on Breitenweg at 127 km/h and on Neuenlander Straße at 121 km/h. These two drivers face fines of at least 680 Euros, a three-month driving ban, and points in the driving aptitude register. The mobile checks were carried out at accident blackspots caused by speeding and at current complaint locations. These included, among others, the streets Arsterdamm, Buntentorsteinweg, Dobbheide, Ehlersdamm, Friedrich-Ebert-Straße, Hastedter Osterdeich, Heinrich-Plett-Allee, and Kirchbachstraße. Excessive speed remains one of the main causes of accidents on Bremen's roads. Through targeted control measures, not only at accident blackspots, speed violations will continue to be consistently prosecuted and speeders removed from traffic in the future.
review_notes: The report concerns speed enforcement, traffic violations, fines and driving bans, not drug-related offences. Road Traffic Accidents is the closest existing topic, but a dedicated traffic enforcement topic would describe the report more accurately.

title_en: Four dead after fire in residential building
description_en: Four people died in a fire in a detached house on Kluvenhagener Straße in Mahndorf on Thursday. The criminal police have launched an investigation into the cause of the fire. Around 8:40 a.m., police and fire department received emergency calls reporting a fire in a residential building on Kluvenhagener Straße. When the emergency and rescue services arrived on the scene with a large contingent, dense smoke and fire clouds had already spread to the upper floor and the roof structure. Three people, including two adults and a child, could only be recovered dead from the house. A second toddler was taken to a clinic with life-threatening injuries. Despite immediate resuscitation on site, it succumbed to its severe injuries in the hospital. Whether the fire victims are the residents of the house, a 47-year-old man and his 40-year-old wife and their two children aged three and five, has not yet been conclusively clarified. Identification is not yet unequivocally possible. The fire was extinguished by the fire department. How the fire started is now being investigated by the criminal police of the Bremen police. Fire investigators have already started investigations into the cause of the fire on site.
review_notes: The report describes a fatal residential fire and an investigation into its cause. It does not concern graffiti or vandalism. Public Appeals and Investigations is a closer existing topic, but a dedicated fire or emergency incidents topic would be more appropriate.

description_en: The demonstration registered for Saturday under the motto "No ban for black-white-red" will not take place. The organizer cancelled the rally this evening. After the OVG Bremen on Friday only permitted the rally under conditions, the organizer contacted the assembly authority in the evening and cancelled the demo. Bremen police will nevertheless show presence in the city area on Saturday, as alternative gatherings cannot be ruled out.
review_notes: The report concerns a planned public demonstration that was cancelled, including police preparations for possible alternative gatherings. The assigned topic is appropriate.

title_en: No luck, and then on top of that, bad luck too.
description_en:
A tire blowout on the highway is unfortunate. If, however, criminal offenses are uncovered as a result, then that is probably bad luck for those involved.

On Friday evening, emergency services from the traffic police secured a loaded car transporter on Autobahn 27 in the direction of Hanover, which had broken down in a construction zone due to a tire blowout. The driver, a 27-year-old man from Poland, claimed he could drive the transporter, but did not have the required authorization to do so. No driver's license means: no driver's license. No driver anymore means: a replacement driver must be found.

So on Saturday morning, two potential replacement drivers dispatched by the transport company appeared at the vehicle's parking location on the Lesum Bridge. The traffic police officers positively noted: The 22-year-old and 26-year-old men were in possession of a valid driver's license. What also turned out "positive," however, was the drug test conducted. No driver means: no driver. The transporter therefore remained in Bremen for another night, while the three men had the opportunity to inform yet another replacement driver.

The trio had to pay a security deposit and now face charges of driving without a license and driving under the influence of intoxicating substances. Further investigations by the traffic investigations department are ongoing.
review_notes: The report concerns a vehicle breakdown followed by police enforcement of licensing and drug-driving laws. No traffic accident occurred. Drug-Related Offences captures part of the incident, but a dedicated traffic violations and enforcement topic would be more appropriate.

description_en:
On Tuesday night, in Steintor, the walls of an underground car park were sprayed with pink and black paint. Three female suspects, aged 19 and 20, were apprehended near the scene.

During the night, a witness in Lübecker Straße became aware of three young women. They were holding spray cans and spraying the entrance to an underground car park. Responding officers stopped the 19 and 20-year-old trio and found the spray cans, which had since been disposed of, in a nearby bin. The items were confiscated. On the walls, slogans such as "Against Misogyny" and "Smash Patriarchy" were observed in freshly applied pink and black paint. The three suspects were provisionally arrested. The police have commenced further investigations into the property damage. Illegal graffiti constitutes property damage; the perpetrator is liable for damages and will be prosecuted.
review_notes: The report describes suspects caught spray-painting an underground car park. Although arrests occurred, graffiti vandalism is the central offence. The assigned topic is appropriate.
